arena: [우선 처치] Mortal Strike reduces healing effects on the target by 50% for 10 sec, so keep it up without gaps on your kill target. With Sharpen Blade, your next Mortal Strike after Colossus Smash deals 15% more damage and reduces healing taken by 50% for 4 sec.
[생존기] Die by the Sword reduces all damage taken by 30% and increases parry chance by 100% for 8 sec. Use it when melee DPS pop their burst cooldowns.
[생존기] Spell Reflection reflects the first spell cast at you and reduces magic damage taken by 20% for 5 sec. Time it right before an enemy caster's CC cast finishes.
[차단] Pummel interrupts a cast and locks that school for 5 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[제어] Storm Bolt stuns a target up to 20 yds away for 4 sec. Lock down the enemy healer and burst during Colossus Smash's 30% damage increase window.
[제어] Disarm disarms an enemy's weapon and shield for 5 sec. Use it when weapon-wielding melee DPS pop their burst cooldowns.

[분담] Berserker Shout removes fear and incapacitate effects from you, makes you immune for 6 sec, and removes fears from allies within 12 yds. With Berserker Roar, the next CC effect within 5 sec has its duration reduced by 50%. Shout it next to your team when the enemy CC chain starts.
[생존기] During Bladestorm you're immune to movement impairing and CC effects. Pop it when you expect an enemy CC chain and keep dealing damage uncontrolled.
bg: [참고] Battleground Blitz groups run 5-6 DPS; healers carry the flag first, or a mobile DPS if none can. Keep up with and protect the carrier using Charge and Heroic Leap.

[광역 피해] With Storm of Destruction, all enemies hit by Bladestorm and Ravager are slowed by 60% for 6 sec and take 50% less healing for 10 sec. Use them on enemies stacked on a base or around the flag carrier.
[우선 처치] Keep Mortal Strike's 50% healing reduction up without gaps on the enemy flag carrier so the enemy healer struggles to keep them alive.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Die by the Sword and Defensive Stance damage reduction first.
[위치] Piercing Howl slows enemies within 12 yds by 70% for 8 sec and makes allies within 6 yds 30% faster for 4 sec. Use it to cut off enemies chasing your flag carrier.
[제어] Enemies feared by Intimidating Shout can't be knocked back. Use it to drive off enemies trying to capture a base, but don't overlap it with your team's knockbacks.
pvpTalents: Sharpen Blade, picked by all top 40 Solo Shuffle players and 45 of 46 Battleground Blitz players, makes your next Mortal Strike after Colossus Smash deal 15% more damage and reduce healing taken by 50% for 4 sec. Storm of Destruction, picked by 37 of 46 Battleground Blitz players, slows enemies hit by Bladestorm and Ravager by 60% for 6 sec and reduces their healing taken by 50%. Berserker Roar, picked by 26 of 40 Solo Shuffle players, adds a 50% duration reduction to allies' next CC effect to Berserker Shout.

5246.m: Talent · 8 yd range · Instant · 1.5 min cooldown
5246.d:
Causes the targeted enemy to cower in fear while all enemies within 8 yards flee from you and their movement speed is reduced by 70% for 8 sec.
Damage may cancel the effect.

12323.d:
Snares all enemies within 12 yards, reducing their movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.

Spurs all allies within 6 yards, increasing their movement speed by 30% for 4 sec.

236077.m: Tank Specs – Row 1 PvP Talent · Melee Range · Instant · 45 sec cooldown
236077.d: Disarm the enemy's weapons and shield for 5 sec. Disarmed creatures deal significantly reduced damage.

236308.d: Bladestorm, Ravager, and Demolish now snare all targets you hit by 60% for 6 sec and decrease their healing taken by 50% for 10 sec.

384100.d:
Go berserk, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap, and Incapacitate effects for 6 sec.

Also remove fear effects from group members within 12 yds.

1219165.d: Colossus Smash causes your next Mortal Strike to deal 15% increased damage and reduce healing taken by 50% for 4 sec.

1227751.d: Berserker Shout also reduces the duration of the next crowd control effect within 5 sec by 50% on group members within 12 yds.

5246.m: 특성 · 8 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
5246.d:
대상을 공포에 질려 제자리에서 떨게 하고, 8초 동안 주위 8미터 내 모든 적의 이동 속도를 70%만큼 감소시킵니다.
피해를 받으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다.

12323.d:
8초 동안 12미터 내에 있는 적의 이동 속도를 70%만큼 감소시킵니다.

6미터 내 모든 아군을 자극하여 4초 동안 이동 속도를 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.

236077.m: 탱커 스펙 – 1열 PvP 특성 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
236077.d: 5초 동안 적의 무기와 방패를 무장 해제시킵니다. 무장 해제된 적은 공격력이 크게 감소합니다.

236308.d: 칼날폭풍과 쇠날발톱, 쇄파가 6초 동안 적중당한 모든 대상을 60%만큼 감속시키고, 10초 동안 받는 치유 효과를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

384100.d:
광폭화하여 6초 동안 공포, 혼절시키기, 행동 불가 상태를 제거하고 면역이 됩니다.

추가로 12미터 내 파티원에게 부여된 공포 효과를 제거합니다.

1219165.d: 거인의 강타가 다음 필사의 일격의 공격력을 15%만큼 증가시키고 4초 동안 받는 치유 효과를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

1227751.d: 광전사의 외침 사용 시 추가로 다음 5초 안에 12미터 내 파티원에게 걸리는 군중 제어 효과의 지속시간이 50%만큼 감소합니다.

note: There is no spec-specific PvP guide source, so these are general principles built from ability and PvP talent tooltips, actual top-player pick rates, and mode and map requirements.

notes: 영웅 특성이 1인 조합전 학살자 37·거신 3, 전장 대공세 학살자 44·거신 2로 학살자가 대부분이지만 한쪽 전용 기술(Demolish 등)은 쓰지 않음
